Data Import

Read in ilabs stock data and select Biopolymers rows

Select both cores with MIT BioMicro Center in name and filter out HTS charges

ilabs <- read.xlsx("../data/stock_ilabs.xlsx")
ilabs.igt <- ilabs %>% dplyr::filter(Core.Name %in% c("KI Genomics Core / MIT BioMicro Center","KI Genomics Core / MIT BioMicro Center and KI High Throughput Sciences Core"))
cat("Dimensions of ilabs.igt:", dim(ilabs.igt), "\n")
## Dimensions of ilabs.igt: 26881 18
ilabs.igt <- ilabs.igt %>% dplyr::filter(!(Category == "Technical Assistance" & stringr::str_starts(Charge.Name, "HTS")))
cat("Dimensions of ilabs.igt:", dim(ilabs.igt), "\n")
## Dimensions of ilabs.igt: 26820 18
rm(ilabs)

Repair ilabs date

ilabs.igt$Purchase.Date <- as.Date(ilabs.igt$Purchase.Date, origin = "1899-12-30")

Check year table to make sure the 2 cores are just a rename - they are, rename started in 2024

ilabs.igt %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Year = lubridate::year(Purchase.Date)) %>%
  dplyr::count(Year, Core.Name) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
## # A tibble: 2 × 7
##   Core.Name                            `2020` `2021` `2022` `2023` `2024` `2025`
##   <chr>                                 <int>  <int>  <int>  <int>  <int>  <int>
## 1 KI Genomics Core / MIT BioMicro Cen…   4690   5895   4960   4249   2993      0
## 2 KI Genomics Core / MIT BioMicro Cen…      0      0      0      0    545   3488

Read in bmc-external and repair problems

Some code has been added here to fix a unprintable character problem

bmc.ext <- read.xlsx("../data/ExtUsage2025_2510.xlsx") %>%
  mutate(LAB = stringr::str_replace_all(LAB, "_x000B_", ""))

Some LAB values are empty, replace them with external

bmc.ext <- bmc.ext %>% dplyr::mutate(LAB = if_else(is.na(LAB), "external", LAB))

Some NUM values are NA, replace them with 1

bmc.ext <- bmc.ext %>% mutate(NUM = replace_na(NUM, 1))

Some COST values are NA

bmc.ext <- bmc.ext %>% mutate(COST = replace_na(COST, 1))

Repair date

bmc.ext$Purchase.Date <- as.Date(bmc.ext$DATE, origin = "1899-12-30")

Exclude DSMI-related charges from bmc.ext

bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext %>% dplyr::filter(!TYPE %in% c("Bioinformatics", "Computing"))

Compare column names in ilabs.dsmi and bmc.ext

colnames(ilabs.igt)
##  [1] "Service.ID"          "Service.Type"        "Customer.Name"      
##  [4] "Customer.Lab"        "Customer.Department" "Customer.Institute" 
##  [7] "Charge.Name"         "Notes"               "Unit.of.Measure"    
## [10] "Quantity"            "Price"               "Total.Price"        
## [13] "Price.Type"          "Purchase.Date"       "Core.Name"          
## [16] "Center"              "Category"            "Usage.Type"
colnames(bmc.ext.igt)
##  [1] "_ID"           "PROJID"        "LAB"           "USER"         
##  [5] "DATE"          "DETAIL"        "NUM"           "COST"         
##  [9] "CostObj"       "TargetObject"  "TYPE"          "Purchase.Date"

Rename columns to match ilabs

bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::rename(Customer.Name = USER)
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::mutate(Service.ID = `_ID`)
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::rename(Customer.Lab = LAB)
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::rename(Charge.Name = DETAIL)
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::rename(Quantity = NUM)
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::rename(Total.Price = COST)
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::rename(Category = TYPE)

Add missing columns needed to match ilabs data

bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::mutate(Price = round(Total.Price/Quantity,2))
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::mutate(Service.Type = "ToUpdate")
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::mutate(Customer.Department = "")
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::mutate(Customer.Institute = "")
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::mutate(Unit.of.Measure = "ToUpdate")
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::mutate(Price.Type = "")
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::mutate(Core.Name = "bmc.ext")
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::mutate(Center = "")
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::mutate(Usage.Type = "")
bmc.ext.igt <- bmc.ext.igt %>% dplyr::mutate(Notes = "")

Select ilabs columns from bmc.ext.igt

bmc.ext.igt.to_rbind <- bmc.ext.igt %>%
  dplyr::select(Service.ID, Service.Type, Customer.Name, Customer.Lab, Customer.Department, 
                Customer.Institute, Charge.Name, Notes, Unit.of.Measure, Quantity, Price, 
                Total.Price, Price.Type, Purchase.Date, Core.Name, Center, Category, 
                Usage.Type)

Join ilabs and bmc.ext.igt

igt.final <- rbind(ilabs.igt,bmc.ext.igt.to_rbind)

Exclude HTS rows using Category information

igt.final <- igt.final %>% dplyr::filter(!stringr::str_starts(Category, "HTS"))

Check dates before reporting range selection

igt.final %>%
  mutate(Year_Month = floor_date(Purchase.Date, "month")) %>%
  count(Year_Month) %>%
  arrange(Year_Month) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year_Month, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "1 month") +
  labs(title = "Records by Month",
       x = "Month",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

Select reporting date range

cat("Dimensions of igt.final before reporting range selection:", dim(igt.final), "\n")

cat("Dimensions of igt.final after reporting range selection:", dim(igt.final), "\n")
## Dimensions of igt.final after reporting range selection: 20291 18

Check dates after reporting range selection

igt.final %>%
  mutate(Year_Month = floor_date(Purchase.Date, "month")) %>%

Faculty Annotation Work

Import faculty key data

fac.key <- read.xlsx("../data/FacultyKeys.xlsx")

Associate Faculty.Key with igt.final

igt.final <- igt.final %>%
  left_join(fac.key %>%
              select(ValueInData, Faculty.Key) %>%
              distinct(), 
            by = c("Customer.Lab" = "ValueInData"))

Import sponsor annotation data

fac.annot <- read.xlsx("../data/annotated.Faculty.Keys.xlsx")

Join to igt.final using Faculty.Key

igt.final <- igt.final %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    fac.annot %>% dplyr::select(Faculty.Key, IGT_DSMI_Sponsor),
    by = "Faculty.Key"
  )

Check for missing Faculty.Key or IGT_DSMI_Sponsor values

igt.final %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(Faculty.Key))

Service Annotation

Parse Charge.Name

igt.final <- igt.final %>% dplyr::mutate(Charge.Name.Short = stringr::str_trim(stringr::str_extract(Charge.Name, "^[^|]*")))

Check for empty or NA rows, if 0 is reported, there are none

sum(is.na(igt.final$Charge.Name.Short)) + sum(igt.final$Charge.Name.Short == "", na.rm = TRUE)
## [1] 0

Prepare and export different usage sets

Charge.Name.Short.table <- as.data.frame(table(igt.final$Charge.Name.Short))
Charge.Name.Short.table <- dplyr::rename(Charge.Name.Short.table,Charge.Name.Short = Var1,RowCount = Freq)
write.xlsx(Charge.Name.Short.table,file="ChargeNameShortTable.xlsx")

Import manually annotated Charge.Name.Short file

Charge.Name.Short.table.annot <- read.xlsx("ChargeNameShortTable_annotated.xlsx")

Join Charge.Name.Short annotations to igt.final

Make a copy of igt.final so it is easier to restart

igt.final.annot <- igt.final
cat("Dimensions of igt.final.annot before joining annotations:", dim(igt.final.annot), "\n")
## Dimensions of igt.final.annot before joining annotations: 20291 22
igt.final.annot <- igt.final.annot %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Charge.Name.Short.table.annot, by = c("Charge.Name.Short" = "Charge.Name.Short"))
cat("Dimensions of igt.final.annot after joining annotations:", dim(igt.final.annot), "\n")
## Dimensions of igt.final.annot after joining annotations: 20291 24

Check for missing group annotations

igt.final.annot %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(group))

Exclude Training rows in Usage.Type.ToExclude

Sample isolation, purification, and initial processing hour relative.spent Training Library Preparation, Automation, and Quality Control hour relative.spent [TRAINING SESSION] OR [ASSISTED USE]

cat("Dimensions of igt.final.annot before excluding:", dim(igt.final.annot), "\n")
## Dimensions of igt.final.annot before excluding: 20291 24
igt.final.annot <- igt.final.annot %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!(group == "Sample isolation, purification, and initial processing" & Usage.Type == "Training"))

  dplyr::filter(!(group == "Library Preparation, Automation, and Quality Control" & Usage.Type %in% c("[TRAINING SESSION]","[ASSISTED USE]")))

Prepare Sample isolation, purification, and initial processing pie chart

samp.pie <- samp %>%
  mutate(Sponsor_ForPlot = factor(Sponsor_ForPlot, levels = sponsor_order)) %>%
  group_by(Sponsor_ForPlot) %>%
  summarise(Quantity = sum(Quantity), 
            Num_Labs = if_else(first(Sponsor_ForPlot) == "Center_Member",
                               n_distinct(Faculty.Key[IGT_DSMI_Sponsor == "KI_member"]),
                               n_distinct(Faculty.Key)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Percent = round((Quantity / sum(Quantity)) * 100, 0),
         Lab_Label = if_else(Sponsor_ForPlot == "Center_Member",
                             paste0(Num_Labs, " Members"),
                             paste0(Num_Labs, " Users")),
         Label = paste0(Quantity, "\n", Percent, "%\n", Lab_Label)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = "", y = Quantity, fill = Sponsor_ForPlot)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3,
            fontface = "bold",
            color = "white") +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sponsor_colors) +
  labs(title = "Sample isolation, purification, and initial processing units",
       fill = "Sponsor") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

samp.pie

Prepare Sample isolation, purification, and initial processing pie chart

lib.pie <- lib %>%
  mutate(Sponsor_ForPlot = factor(Sponsor_ForPlot, levels = sponsor_order)) %>%
  group_by(Sponsor_ForPlot) %>%
  summarise(Quantity = sum(Quantity), 
            Num_Labs = if_else(first(Sponsor_ForPlot) == "Center_Member",
                               n_distinct(Faculty.Key[IGT_DSMI_Sponsor == "KI_member"]),
                               n_distinct(Faculty.Key)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Percent = round((Quantity / sum(Quantity)) * 100, 0),
         Lab_Label = if_else(Sponsor_ForPlot == "Center_Member",
                             paste0(Num_Labs, " Members"),
                             paste0(Num_Labs, " Users")),
         Label = paste0(Quantity, "\n", Percent, "%\n", Lab_Label)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = "", y = Quantity, fill = Sponsor_ForPlot)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3,
            fontface = "bold",
            color = "white") +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sponsor_colors) +
  labs(title = "Library Preparation, Automation, and Quality Control ",
       fill = "Sponsor") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

lib.pie

Prepare Sample isolation, purification, and initial processing pie chart

seq.pie <- seq %>%
  mutate(Sponsor_ForPlot = factor(Sponsor_ForPlot, levels = sponsor_order)) %>%
  group_by(Sponsor_ForPlot) %>%
  summarise(Quantity = sum(Quantity), 
            Num_Labs = if_else(first(Sponsor_ForPlot) == "Center_Member",
                               n_distinct(Faculty.Key[IGT_DSMI_Sponsor == "KI_member"]),
                               n_distinct(Faculty.Key)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Percent = round((Quantity / sum(Quantity)) * 100, 0),
         Lab_Label = if_else(Sponsor_ForPlot == "Center_Member",
                             paste0(Num_Labs, " Members"),
                             paste0(Num_Labs, " Users")),
         Label = paste0(Quantity, "\n", Percent, "%\n", Lab_Label)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = "", y = Quantity, fill = Sponsor_ForPlot)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3,
            fontface = "bold",
            color = "white") +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sponsor_colors) +
  labs(title = "Sequencing and Oligonucleotide Synthesis Units",
       fill = "Sponsor") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

seq.pie

Plot the pie charts figure

samp.pie + lib.pie + spatial.pie + seq.pie + plot_layout(ncol = 4, guides = "collect")

combo.pie <- samp.pie + lib.pie + spatial.pie + seq.pie + plot_layout(ncol = 4, guides = "collect")
ggsave("figures/IGT_combo.pie.pdf",
       plot = combo.pie,
       dpi = 150,
       width = 20,
       height = 4,
       units = "in")
